claims.text: Under the 2023 Fed stress test severely adverse scenario, the aggregate CET1 ratio of the 23 banks fell from an actual 12.4% (2022:Q4) to a projected minimum of 9.9%, then rose to 10.5% by the end of the projection horizon; aggregate and individual post-stress CET1 ratios remained well above required minimums throughout.

citations.quotation:
The aggregate and individual bank post-stress
common equity tier 1 (CET1) capital ratios remain well above the required minimum levels
throughout the projection horizon.

the aggregate CET1 capital ratio of the 23 banks falls from
an actual 12.4 percent in the fourth quarter of 2022 to its minimum of 9.9 percent, before rising
to 10.5 percent at the end of the projection

counterarguments.text: The conclusion that banks remain above minimums rests on modeled projections rather than realized outcomes; the values after 2022:Q4 are Fed projections under a hypothetical scenario, so actual future capital levels could differ if conditions deviate from assumptions.
